llm_response.reason: The website displays hallmarks of a fake online shopping scam: it lists high-end brand items at 'outlet' discounts of 70–80% off, which are far below genuine market values. There is no verifiable company, business identifiers, or real contact information on display. The domain was registered just days ago, with all WHOIS registrant information hidden, which further reduces credibility. The site structure and navigation are similar to known scam storefront templates. No evidence supports this as a legitimate business, and it exhibits multiple scam characteristics according to the listed criteria.
